audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0 and 4 said Skill and row 6 said Renekton, while the whys said 'pre-fury level 1 you out-sustain his slap', 'Infinite Duress locks him... your spike' and 'late game is skill'.
audit.why: Packet chart is [Warwick, Renekton, Renekton, Skill, Warwick, Renekton, Skill] at 53.3%, and the mirror already corrected the two-plus-items row to Skill on its side. Pre-fury he has no stun, and at 6 you gain a 1.5s suppression while he gains health.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 4 to Warwick, row 6 to Skill, both layers as matched pairs; level-6 rating raised.

audit.why: Spike order is right — his fury window at 3-5, your level 6, his first item, then parity — but the level-6 spike sentence was garbled and unusable.
audit.corrected: Rewrote it around Ruthless Predator's real stun durations (0.75s, 1.5s empowered) and Dominus' 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text said to ult 'when his fury is empty and he can't cancel your channel' without ever stating why, and called his E 'Dice'.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is flagged interruptible, and Ruthless Predator stuns for 0.75s base and 1.5s above 50 Fury — that stun is precisely what cancels your leap, which is the whole reason the fury bar matters. His E is Slice and Dice, two casts on 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s. Cull the Meek heals him, so Grievous Wounds is genuinely core here.
audit.corrected: Stated the stun-cancels-leap rule with numbers and used the real ability name throughout.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Renekton's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses for 1.5s, but his stun cancels the leap — ult with his fury bar empty. Dominus is 120s and hands him bonus health.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Renekton carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on it is fury management against your ultimate timing. Renekton carry threat 7/10 — take the side lane, refuse the coin flip.

edits.before: This is Renekton's window: with full fury he dashes in with Ruthless Predator (W) stun, Cull the Meek (Q) heal, and Dice (E) resets — he out-trades and out-sustains you badly before 6.
edits.after: This is Renekton's window: on full fury he opens with Ruthless Predator (W) for a 1.5s stun, heals off Cull the Meek (Q, 7s), and resets with Slice and Dice — he out-trades you before 6.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is your equaliser — his W stun is point-blank and his empowered W only stuns while it's up, so ult when his fury is empty and he can't cancel your channel.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is your equaliser, but Ruthless Predator stuns 0.75s — 1.5s on full fury — and any CC cancels the leap, so ult with his fury bar empty and his W spent.

edits.before: With a completed bruiser item and fury back online Renekton's double-E Dice mobility and W stun let him pick the trade and disengage yours.
edits.after: With a completed bruiser item and fury back online his two Slice and Dice casts and the W stun let him pick the trade and disengage yours.

edits.before: Levels 2-5 are his: full-fury Ruthless Predator (W) point-blank stuns you out of everything while Cull the Meek (Q) heals him through your damage and Dice (E) resets his engage. Respect the stun and give ground until 6.
edits.after: Levels 2-5 are his: full-fury Ruthless Predator (W) stuns you for 1.5s out of everything, Cull the Meek (Q, 7s) heals him through your damage, and Slice and Dice resets his engage. Give ground until 6.

edits.before: Use both E Dice charges to dodge your Q and reset trades
edits.after: Use both Slice and Dice casts to dodge your Q and reset

edits.before: Q-bite Renekton as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite Renekton while his fury bar is empty, weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger out-heal his return damage.

edits.before: Q-bite Renekton as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite Renekton while his fury bar is empty, weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger out-heal his return damage.

edits.before: Trading into his full burst window with E down — fear is your trade-flipper; without it you are just a sustain bot.
edits.after: Trading into his empowered W with Primal Howl down — its 15s fear is your trade-flipper; without it you are a sustain bot.
